```python
class MeshCreateSpec(Value)
```

Specification for creating a mesh. An omitted ID allocates a fresh UUID when
creation executes; an empty texture_asset_id leaves the texture unassigned.

| `name` | `str` | Required | Human-readable display name; use the stable ID for identity because names can change. |
| `geometry` | `MeshGeometry` | Required | Owned vertex IDs, positions, UVs and triangles; triangles contain vertex IDs, not<br>position offsets. |
| `texture_asset_id` | `str` | `""` | Image-asset ID used by this mesh; the default empty string leaves its texture<br>reference unassigned. |

## zipzi.values.MeshGeometry

```python
class MeshGeometry(Value)
```

Vertex IDs, authoring-space positions, texture UVs and triangle connectivity for a mesh.
Positions and UVs follow vertex_ids order; triangles contain vertex IDs.
Positions use model space without a deformation parent, otherwise the parent's
local/parameter space.

| Field | Type | Constructor default (wire JSON) | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `vertex_ids` | `tuple[int, ...]` | Required | Stable vertex IDs in the same order as positions and UVs; IDs need not be contiguous. |
| `positions` | `tuple[common.Vec2, ...]` | Required | Absolute XY coordinates in the mesh authoring space (model space without a deformation<br>parent, otherwise the parent's local/parameter space), ordered by vertex_ids. |
| `uvs` | `tuple[common.Vec2, ...]` | Required | Texture UV coordinates ordered by vertex_ids. |
| `triangles` | `tuple[tuple[int, ...], ...]` | Required | Triangle entries reference vertex_ids values, never offsets into positions. |
| `meshing` | `MeshMeshing \| None` | `null` | Optional canonical UV boundary and retained internal structure edges. |
